changes: First release: 174 programs of the Alesis Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex on FX2, played at the originals' own arithmetic.
PROG picks the program and BANK the unit; a message box names each as you turn. STOP, STOP, STOP cuts the tail.
Known issue: on base 0.8.1 the first NO after picking it only closes the memory box; press FX2 for its page instead.
Known issue: the Midiverb II's chorus and flange programs, and 31 programs that need more DSP time, are not in this release.
